<user_query>
In the AllTrue codebase at /home/admin, investigate how student name lookup/binding works. Specifically:

1. Read /home/admin/frontend/src/pages/ParentPortal.vue - look for how parent login works (student name + phone matching)
2. Read /home/admin/backend/app/Http/Controllers/ParentPortalController.php - look at the login method and how it searches for students
3. Read /home/admin/backend/app/Http/Controllers/StudentController.php - look at how student name update works
4. Check if there are any caching mechanisms, normalized name fields, or search indexes that might cause stale data after a name change

The bug: after changing a student's name, some "binding" (绑定) still cannot find student data. The image shows a student card with "林澤清 國中一年級(J1) 延平".

Report:
- What fields are used for student lookup in each relevant feature (ParentPortal login, RFID binding, etc.)
- Whether there are any cached/denormalized name fields that don't get updated when Student.name changes
- The exact SQL/Eloquent queries used for student name matching
- Any normalization (trimming, case conversion) applied to names during search vs storage
</user_query>

Tracing student name lookup and binding across ParentPortal, backend controllers, and related flows.
